# Reference versions for the one-time .pth -> .onnx conversion toolchain.
#
# The supported way to get these is the nix flake, which pins the exact same
# set through nixpkgs:
#
#     nix develop
#
# This file exists for non-nix users and to document what the scripts in
# tools/ were verified against.

torchvision==0.28.0
spandrel==0.4.2
onnx==1.21.0
onnxscript==0.7.1
onnxruntime==1.27.1
numpy==2.5.1

rich==15.0.0
